Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026

This policy explains how this page handles information when you visit. We keep it simple: this is a static links page, and we collect as little as possible.

1. Information we collect

We do not ask you to create an account or submit personal information on this page. We do not sell your data.

2. Analytics

This site may use privacy-conscious analytics (such as Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics) to understand aggregate traffic — for example, how many people visit and which links are popular. This may involve cookies or similar technologies that collect standard, non-identifying information like your browser type, approximate region, and the pages you view. You can block cookies in your browser settings.

3. Links to other sites

This page links to third-party platforms (such as social media, subscription, and payment services). Once you follow a link, that destination's own privacy policy applies. We have no control over, and are not responsible for, how those third parties handle your information.

4. Your choices

You can decline cookies, use private browsing, or leave the site at any time. Because we do not collect identifying information here, there is no account to delete.

5. Children

This site is intended for adults (18+) and is not directed to children.

6. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The "last updated" date above reflects the most recent version.

7. Contact

Questions about privacy can be directed through the contact options linked on the main page.
